title: ***UPDATE SEPT 2015*** SHRINKS Dropping to 2 stars Lost four inches in 60 days
text:
***UPDATE SEPT 2015*** SHRINKS Dropping to 2 stars Lost four inches in 60 days. This is heavy, but it's being used in a camp style shower with a two side opening so the heft is a good thing. It hangs and doesn't flop around or gape. Typically, there's just one person using this on any given day so it gets wet, dries totally and we haven't seen any mildew etc This does get properly washed every week as well and it's surviving that well.

***********UPDATE September 20, 2015 ***********

I am downgrading this to two stars because it has shrunk almost four full inches since July. It is now four inches shorter and we had to hook two shower hooks together all the way around in order to hang it so that it goes to the bottom of the shower stall. Ridiculous!

product_metadata.title: Bean Products Cotton Stall Shower Curtain (White), [36" x 74"] | All Natural Materials - Made in USA | Works with Tub, Bath and Stall Showers
features: SUPREME QUALITY AND DURABILITY : Coming in seven durable and beautiful fabrics, our shower curtains are sure to fit any bathroom decor. This sturdy design keeps its shape, and does not billow in like other conventional shower curtains.

LEAKPROOF: We use wide, durable fabric to allow our shower curtains to dry rapidly. Our cotton canvas has a subtle translucence that allows light to penetrate through to aid in the drying process. All curtains are made with high quality rust proof nickel plated brass grommets.

MULTIPURPOSE: This high quality shower curtain can be used with a tub, bath or stall shower. This design can also be used as a curtain, drape and/or room divider making it the perfect multipurpose shower curtain.

NATURAL AND NON TOXIC: Better for you and the environment. These shower curtains are all handmade with all natural and non toxic materials unlike other conventional shower curtains. Made without inhalable toxic phthalates found in many plastic curtains.

LOCALLY MADE & SUSTAINABLE: 33 years of Made in America, Bean Products are made to last from the best eco-friendly materials available - sustainably sourced & domestically produced by a family run business in the USA.
